decisions.reason: The vertigo combination tablet sits close to the firm's established offer, likely draws on its patented formulation know-how, and has a dedicated page signalling visible commitment, so management will persist and attribute any slow uptake to the launch phase.

The generic antidepressant is distant from the core and exposed to tender price pressure, but the approval and launch costs already sunk, its dedicated page and its recent 2024 launch lead management to keep it and treat weak results as temporary.

The combination antihypertensive film tablet fits the firm's established prescription portfolio and its direction of improved, adherence-supporting formulations, and its dedicated page makes withdrawal after one year unlikely.

The bone and joint supplement is only mentioned on the website, a weaker public commitment, but it supports the announced shift toward pharmacy-exclusive self-care products and is cheap to maintain, so it is kept.
